facts.fact: Communications Authority Director General David Mugonyi says Kenya promulgated the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse (Critical Information Infrastructure and Cybercrime Management) Regulations in early 2024 to secure critical information infrastructure in sectors such as e-government, telecommunications, banking, transport, energy and health.
